highlights.degree: Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech)

overview: Pursuing a Master’s in Computer Engineering in Finland can help students strengthen their technical knowledge, develop problem-solving skills and prepare for careers in engineering, software development and research. Depending on their academic background, students can choose specialised programmes in computer engineering, computer science or information and communication technology. Students planning to Study Computer Engineering in Finland can benefit from an international learning environment and opportunities to work on research projects and industry-related assignments. faq.question: Can Indian students apply for a Master’s in Computer Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply if they hold a recognised bachelor

faq.question: What are the Master’s in Computer Engineering in Finland Fees?
faq.answer: Tuition fees vary by institution and programme. The examples discussed in this article range from €10,000 to €17,000 per year for selected related programmes. Applicants should confirm current tuition fees and scholarship conditions directly with their chosen university.

faq.question: How can Edu-Hawk Worldwide help students apply?
faq.answer: Edu-Hawk Worldwide helps students explore suitable universities, understand eligibility and admission requirements, organise application documents and compare study options. Applicants should confirm programme availability, tuition fees, deadlines and final admission decisions through the official university.
